description: SQL-free data query with WHERE, SELECT, aggregation, ORDER BY, JOIN, pivot, DISTINCT, transforms, and Mercury scoring

aggregate.description: JSON array of aggregation specs, e.g. [{"field": "amount", "func": "sum"}]. Funcs: count, sum, avg, min, max, stddev

distinct.description: Return only unique rows based on selected fields. Cannot combine with aggregate or pivot.

join.description: JSON object of join config, e.g. {"file": "other", "on": "id", "type": "inner"}

mercury.description: JSON object of mercury scoring config, e.g. {"fields": [{"field": "score", "target": 100, "weight": 1.0}]}

order_by.description: JSON sort spec — single object or array for multi-column sort, e.g. [{"field": "dept", "dir": "asc"}, {"field": "salary", "dir": "desc"}]

pivot.description: JSON object of pivot config, e.g. {"row": "category", "column": "month", "values": "sales"}

transform.description: JSON array of transforms applied before WHERE, e.g. [{"field": "email", "func": "lower"}]. Funcs: upper, lower, trim, substring (start, length), replace (old, new), length, date_trunc (unit: year/month/day/hour), date_extract (part: year/month/day/hour/minute/weekday)

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

where.description: JSON array of filter conditions, e.g. [{"field": "status", "op": "eq", "value": "active"}]. Ops: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, between, contains, starts_with, in, not_in, date_within, date_before, date_after. For in/not_in, value is a JSON array. For date_within, value is relative like "30d", "6h", "15m".

name: chaprola_query
